el::IF-6::R.causeDescription: No logging of physical interface connections — who connected and when is unknown
el::IF-6::R.threatDescription: Interface access repudiation — physical interface access cannot be attributed

el::IF-6::S.attackDescription: Attacker connects a rogue device to the interface and impersonates a legitimate system, gaining unauthorized access
el::IF-6::S.causeDescription: No hardware authentication on the interface — any device connecting is trusted without verification
el::IF-6::S.threatDescription: Interface identity spoofing — attacker impersonates a legitimate device on the interface

el::IF-6::T.attackDescription: Attacker modifies the interface hardware or firmware to intercept, inject, or block communications
el::IF-6::T.causeDescription: Interface lacks tamper detection and physical protection — unauthorized modification is possible without detection
el::IF-6::T.threatDescription: Interface tampering — attacker physically or logically tampers with the interface

el::PB-1::D.attackDescription: Attacker physically damages the device or cuts power, causing immediate loss of availability
el::PB-1::D.causeDescription: No physical protection or anchoring — device can be damaged, unplugged, or destroyed
el::PB-1::D.threatDescription: Physical destruction or power disruption — device rendered unavailable by physical attack

el::PB-1::E.attackDescription: Attacker opens the physical boundary and connects to internal debug interface, bypassing all software authentication
el::PB-1::E.causeDescription: Physical access to device interior grants debug/hardware access — logical security can be bypassed
el::PB-1::E.threatDescription: Physical privilege escalation — attacker gains elevated system access via physical boundary breach

el::PB-1::I.attackDescription: Attacker measures power consumption or EM emissions and extracts cryptographic keys
el::PB-1::I.causeDescription: Physical boundary provides no electromagnetic shielding — internal operations are observable
el::PB-1::I.threatDescription: Side-channel observation — sensitive data extracted via physical measurements

el::PB-1::T.attackDescription: Attacker opens the enclosure without triggering any alarm, gaining access to internal components
el::PB-1::T.causeDescription: No tamper detection mechanism — unauthorized opening is undetected
el::PB-1::T.threatDescription: Physical boundary tampering — unauthorized physical access to boundary interior
